title: Move a companion Saga without breaking code links
preconditions: A companion Saga contains a current code link resolved from its selected source checkout.

steps.action: Read the linked fragment while the Saga is separate from the source checkout.
steps.expected_result: The code selector resolves as current.

steps.action: Move the unchanged Saga directory into the source repository and read the same fragment without --repo.
steps.expected_result: The same selector projection remains current at the same target.

expected_result: Repository-relative code links survive moving the companion Saga into its source repository.
